conventions.name: init-files-are-barrels
conventions.description: Package __init__.py files should only define the package public API through docstrings, imports, __all__, and re-export aliases.
conventions.hint: Move non-barrel logic (functions, classes, business logic) out of this __init__.py into a dedicated module and re-export it here instead.

conventions.name: absolute-imports-only
conventions.description: Non-barrel Python modules should use absolute imports instead of relative imports.
conventions.hint: Rewrite relative imports (from . import x, from .. import y) as absolute imports rooted at the top-level package.

conventions.name: no-underscore-exports
conventions.description: Modules should not list underscore-prefixed names in __all__.
conventions.hint: Drop the underscore-prefixed name from __all__, or rename it without the leading underscore if it's meant to be public.

conventions.name: class-name-matches-filename
conventions.description: A *_service.py module should export a PascalCase Service class matching the file stem.
conventions.hint: Export a PascalCase Service class named after this file's stem, e.g. order_service.py should export OrderService.

conventions.name: exported-constants-are-upper-case
conventions.description: A constant module should export an uppercase constant derived from the file name.
conventions.hint: Export a CONSTANT_CASE constant named after this file, e.g. max_retries.py should export MAX_RETRIES.

conventions.name: docstrings-on-public-api
conventions.description: Public classes and functions should have docstrings.
conventions.hint: Add a docstring explaining what this public class or function does, its parameters, and what it returns.

conventions.name: annotated-public-functions
conventions.description: Public functions and methods should annotate parameters and return values.
conventions.hint: Add type annotations to this public function's parameters and return value.

conventions.name: paired-test-files
conventions.description: Top-level source modules should have matching tests/test_<module>.py files.
conventions.hint: Add a tests/test_<module>.py covering this module's public behavior.

conventions.name: no-todo-comments
conventions.description: Source modules should not contain TODO/FIXME/XXX markers; track work in the issue tracker instead.
conventions.hint: Remove the marker and file a tracked issue for the remaining work instead of leaving it in a comment.

conventions.name: public-api-modules-declare-all
conventions.description: Non-package-root modules that expose a public API should declare __all__ explicitly.
conventions.hint: Add an explicit __all__ list naming the names this module intends to expose publicly.

conventions.name: package-inits-have-docstrings
conventions.description: Package __init__.py files should document the package's public API with a module docstring.
conventions.hint: Add a module docstring to this __init__.py summarizing what the package exposes and why.

conventions.name: component-packages-have-readme
conventions.description: Each top-level component package under packages/ should include a README describing its purpose.
conventions.hint: Add a README.md to this package describing its purpose, ownership, and how to use it.
